searchText: **CONSIGNMENT** Used DRV 5th Wheel for sale - 2023 DRV Mobile Suites 41RKSB is approximately 43' 1' in length with 4 slides. Features Bedroom Walk-In Closet Fireplace Dual Recliners Pull-Out Garbage Can Residential Hide-a-Bed Sofa More About This RV This rear kitchen fifth wheel is packed with luxury features you won't want to miss out on. The chef of the family will have ample counter space, a residential dishwasher, plus a stainless steel French door refrigerator to store fresh ingredients. Since this model includes four slides, your family will have plenty of space to unwind and relax, or let the dog stretch out and nap on the floor. This model features unique steps that will create a spacious hallway. Here, you'll enjoy a linen closet, a closet that has been prepped to add an optional washer and dryer, plus the full bath is easily accessible. You and your spouse will feel right at home with your own king bed slide out and a walk-in closet. Now, that's what I call luxury! With any Mobile Suites fifth wheel by DRV Luxury Suites you will enjoy durable construction, beautiful interiors, and tons of storage spaces. The MORryde I.S suspension with MORryde pin box helps absorb road shock for a smooth towing experience, and the six point hydraulic leveling system will make set-up a breeze. Each model includes hassle-free conveniences, like the SeeLevel tank monitoring, the fully ducted A/C system with cold air return, solar prep, and much more! The interior is packed with luxury features, such as custom hardwood wardrobe doors, LED ceiling lights with dimmer switches, crown molding throughout, and custom hand laid glass backsplash. You may spend all your time relaxing indoors, but don't forget to check out the exterior. A power awning with LED lights, extra thick compartment doors with gas struts, and a custom painted exterior with clear coat are just a few features that are sure to be a deal breaker!
